study: exploratory local Heliox UI same-state navigation and appearance-shift probe

source.capture_note: Fresh headless browser storage; no daemon was listening. This set predates the collector's same-origin network restriction. Raw screenshots were not retained.

dark_theme_diagnostic.capture_note: Fresh browser profile, same-origin HTTP only, daemon WebSocket blocked; dark theme unseen during model fit.

interpretation: A small same-appearance action signal appears on held-out viewport families, but the frozen model is worse than unchanged-screen prediction on a 16-row dark-theme holdout. This does not establish appearance-robust action grounding, multi-step consistency, general desktop transfer, safety, or Jev parity. No weights were promoted to the live UiJepaPredictor.
resource_limit: An initial 12-pair-per-family dark-theme run was stopped without saving an artifact when free system-disk space fell below 0.5 GiB. A guarded eight-pair-per-family rerun completed and supplied the 16-row dark evaluation above.
